full_judgment: 3. The principal defendants contested the suit by filing a Written statement contending that Dharani Dhar Sarkar was owner in possession of the suit land and that he died leaving behind 2 sons in Kanti Ram Sarkar and Dhirendra Nath Sarkar and that Dharani Nath Sarkar himself used to cultivate the suit land in khas and after his death, his sons were in possession of the suit land by cultivating the suit land themselves by their own plough and while in such possession Kanti Ram Sarkar and Dhirendra Nath Sarkar sold 40 decimals of Kha schedule land to defendant No. 1 by the registered kabala dated 13-11-1972 and out him in possession and that Dhirendra Nath Sarkar who was in possession, transferred his 8 annas share in Ka schedule land by registered deed in favour of Harmuza Bibi who is proforma defendant No. 6 and Mallika Bibi, who is defendant No. 7 and put them in possession. Kanti Ram Sarkar also transferred his 8 annas share in the Ka schedule land by registered sale deed dated 20-7-1974 to one Hazrat Ali and Shajahan and put them in possession. The contesting defendants alleged that the plaintiffs alleged case of settlement granted by Dharani Dhar Sarkar in favour of Matiur Rahman was false, frivolous and collusive and that the owner Dharani Dhar Sarkar never granted any settlement of the suit land and that he died leaving behind his 2 sons, who sold the suit land to the defendants and the plaintiff by creating false documents instituted the suit and prayed for dismissal of the suit.
